journey.name: scan onchain amount over hardware spendable
journey.description: Verifies that an on-chain BIP21 request whose amount a paired hardware wallet's balance covers, but not once the network fee is taken, shows the Insufficient Savings toast instead of opening the Send Amount screen with a fixed amount that cannot be changed or continued. Nothing is broadcast. Precondition: an onboarded dev wallet with 0 sats in Savings and a paired Bridge emulator (see README.md) whose native-segwit account holds a confirmed regtest balance B of at least 10 000 sats, read from its home tile. Use an amount between B minus 100 sats and B, which the balance covers but the balance minus any non-zero fee does not, and a regtest address the wallet does not own. Start on the wallet home screen. The Send Amount screen is identified by its number field (testTag "SendNumberField"), the Confirm screen by its amount (testTag "ReviewAmount").

actions.action: Read the paired Trezor's balance B from its home tile and pick an amount A with B - 100 < A < B, written in BTC
Run adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "bitcoin:<regtest address>?amount=<A>" to.bitkit.dev

Verify the Insufficient Savings toast (testTag "InsufficientSavingsToast") appears (screenshot), and neither the Send Amount screen (testTag "SendNumberField") nor the Confirm screen (testTag "ReviewAmount") opens
Pick an amount below B by at least 2 000 sats and run the same deep link with it
Verify the Confirm screen opens with the Trezor as the funding source and the amount shown (testTag "ReviewAmount"); close the sheet without sending
